Three-month price momentum of +40.3% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 81/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +33.7% over the past quarter.
